summary: Flat 18-tooth, 8mm-pitch (05B) chain sprocket. It has a 14mm center bore and a ring of small holes around the bore. The disc axis is along z.

mountingSurfaces.description: Front flat face of the sprocket disc, around the 14mm bore and 4mm holes
Back flat face of the sprocket disc, around the 14mm bore and 4mm holes

notes: The drawing prints a 49.2mm outer diameter, 46.1mm pitch diameter, 2.4mm thickness, 14mm bore and 4mm holes. The four round 4mm holes sit on a 16mm square pattern, so I placed them at (±8, ±8). The drawing also shows four slotted holes on the x and y axes at about 11.3mm radius. They are not dimensioned, so I left them out of the holes list. The 24mm dimension is ambiguous against the 16mm spacing and was not used. The 18-tooth count comes from the product data.
